message.content: I'll run two independent probes: an exhaustive bitwise sweep of all finite FP16 encodings (c1) and a focused probe on the subnormal-output region x ∈ [-18.5, -11.1] (c2).

import sys, os, json
sys.path.insert(0, "/root/cases/case_149")
import torch, kernel

# all finite FP16 bit patterns (exclude NaN/Inf exponent=0x1F except zero subnormals are fine)
patterns = [i for i in range(65536) if not (i >> 10) == 0x1F]
x = torch.tensor(patterns, dtype=torch.int32).view(torch.float16).to("cuda")
assert x.numel() <= 131072 and torch.isfinite(x).all()

out = kernel.run(x)
ref = kernel.reference(x)
ok = out.view(torch.int16) == ref.view(torch.int16)
mismatches = (~ok).nonzero().flatten()
n_mismatch = int(mismatches.numel())
fail = []
for idx in mismatches[:10].tolist():
    xv = x[idx].item()
    fail.append({"x": xv, "x_bits": hex(x[idx].view(torch.int16).item()),
                 "got_bits": hex(out[idx].view(torch.int16).item()),
                 "got": out[idx].item(),
                 "want_bits": hex(ref[idx].view(torch.int16).item()),
                 "want": ref[idx].item()})
print(json.dumps({"n_tested": x.numel(), "n_mismatch": n_mismatch,
                  "first_failures": fail}))
", "expected_signal": "count of bit-exact mismatches vs reference over all finite FP16 inputs"}

import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, "/root/cases/case_149")
import torch, kernel

# negative FP16 inputs in the subnormal-output region -18.5 < x <= -11.0
patterns = [i for i in range(65536) if not (i >> 10) == 0x1F]
xall = torch.tensor(patterns, dtype=torch.int32).view(torch.float16)
sel = (xall < -11.0) & (xall > -18.5)
x = xall[sel].to("cuda")
out = kernel.run(x)
ref = kernel.reference(x)
out_bits = out.view(torch.int16); ref_bits = ref.view(torch.int16)
mism = (out_bits != ref_bits).nonzero().flatten()
# check whether outputs that should be nonzero subnormals were flushed to zero
should_subnormal = (ref.view(torch.float16).abs() > 0) & (ref_bits & 0x7FFF != 0)
n = int(x.numel())
res = {"n_tested": n, "n_mismatch": int(mism.numel()),
       "flushed_to_zero": int(((out_bits & 0x7FFF) == 0).sum() - ((ref_bits & 0x7FFF) == 0).sum())}
fail = []
for idx in mism[:10].tolist():
    fail.append({"x": x[idx].item(), "got": out[idx].item(),
                 "got_bits": hex(out_bits[idx].item()),
                 "want_bits": hex(ref_bits[idx].item())})
res["first_failures"] = fail
print(json.dumps(res))
", "expected_signal": "bitwise mismatch count in subnormal-output region vs reference"}
